# Minarro Labs repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.base.md`, root `AGENTS.md` and relevant product docs before meaningful work. Automatically apply proportionate independent technical, commercial, user, product, quality, security, design and simplification review; the operator should not need special prompt syntax.

Use `.agents/roles/` and `.agents/skills/` when supported. For meaningful user-facing work, design quality, responsive behaviour, accessibility and complete UI states are part of done.

Keep output synthesized: concrete blockers first, then important improvements. Prefer the smallest solution that preserves user/product value, correctness and security.
